entities.name: Ham1-like dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase
observations: The 201-aa query has 81.3% identity and 98.5% query coverage to reviewed Streptomyces dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase Q82D15.
Query contains a Ham1p_like domain (PF01725.22; residues 5–194; i-Evalue 1.4e-63).
Homolog annotations describe Mg2+-dependent hydrolysis of XTP, dITP and ITP to the corresponding monophosphates and diphosphate; likely nucleotide-pool sanitization.

entities.name: Purine NTP catabolism
observations: Homologs are annotated to purine nucleoside triphosphate catabolic process (GO:0009146).
